headline: RAC1 randomizer gains gold-weapon case shuffling and an optional New Game+ start
summary: Ratchet & Clank's item randomizer gains optional gold-weapon case shuffling and a separate New Game+ start, both off by default (#199, #197). Shuffling opens the Novalis shop without New Game+ and lets players buy a gold case without its base weapon, while retaining the normal bolt price and four Gold Bolts. Archipelago gets the same gold-case purchase and shop-access fixes (#198). Cheats 0.4.0 also lands, adding its controls to OpenRAC's own in-game menu (#203).
highlights: The New Game+ option enables the retail mode flag and Goodies menu without granting gold weapons or completed-save inventory. It respects the existing seed/save gate and never downgrades an earned New Game+ save (#197).

Both RAC1 randomizers open Big Al's door when the Heli-Pack is owned or his randomized reward is bought. Helga's return taxi stays available until the Swingshot is owned, even after buying her reward (#204).
#207 proposes randomized reward names in NPC prompts, including Archipelago recipient names for other players' items. It remained unmerged.

Draft #212 proposes immediate switches and a choice for Cheats 0.4.1. It awaits a released SDK interface 1.19 or later. The merged 0.4.0 menu applies presses when the game ticks again after the menu closes.

Enhanced Movement 1.0.0 and Travel Anywhere 0.1.2 were submitted for listing, with replacement listing PRs #210 and #211 still open. Wrench Throw 1.0.3 also awaits review before players receive the update (#213).
